title: OmniReview: A Large-scale Benchmark and LLM-enhanced Framework for Realistic Reviewer Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2602.08896v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Academic peer review remains the cornerstone of scholarly validation, yet the field faces some challenges in data and methods. From the data perspective, existing research is hindered by the scarcity of large-scale, verified benchmarks and oversimplified evaluation metrics that fail to reflect real-world editorial workflows. To bridge this gap, we present OmniReview, a comprehensive dataset constructed by integrating multi-source academic platforms encompassing comprehensive scholarly profiles through the disambiguation pipeline, yielding 202, 756 verified review records. Based on this data, we introduce a three-tier hierarchical evaluaion framework to assess recommendations from recall to precise expert identification. From the method perspective, existing embedding-based approaches suffer from the information bottleneck of semantic compression and limited interpretability. To resolve these method limitations, we propose Profi

translated_title: OmniReview：面向现实审稿人推荐的大规模基准数据集与大语言模型增强框架
translated_abstract: 学术同行评审仍然是学术验证的基石，然而该领域在数据和方法方面面临诸多挑战。从数据角度来看，现有研究受制于大规模、经过验证的基准数据集的稀缺，以及无法反映真实编辑工作流程的过度简化的评估指标。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了OmniReview，这是一个通过整合多源学术平台构建的综合数据集，经由消歧处理管道涵盖全面的学者档案，最终产出202,756条经过验证的审稿记录。基于这些数据，我们引入了一个三层分级评估框架，从召回层面到精确的专家识别层面来评估推荐效果。从方法角度来看，现有的基于嵌入的方法存在语义压缩导致的信息瓶颈以及可解释性有限的问题。为解决这些方法上的局限性，我们提出了Profi（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了OmniReview，通过构建包含202,756条验证审稿记录的大规模基准数据集、三层分级评估框架以及大语言模型增强方法，解决了审稿人推荐中数据稀缺、评估指标过于简化以及嵌入方法信息瓶颈与可解释性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents OmniReview, a large-scale benchmark with 202,756 verified review records, a three-tier hierarchical evaluation framework, and an LLM-enhanced approach to address data scarcity, oversimplified metrics, and the information bottleneck and limited interpretability of embedding-based reviewer recommendation methods.
